authenticity_review: The image suffers from significant structural and textural artifacts. A heavy, uniform grainy noise overlay obscures fine details across the entire scene (severity 3). More critically, the elephant's lower legs exhibit severe structural collapse, dissolving into the background haze without clear ground contact or anatomical definition (melting artifact, severity 4). The lion cubs show minor fusion with the water surface at their paws (severity 2). These defects significantly reduce authenticity. The animal_pose_auditor flagged low confidence in hind limb keypoints (risk level LOW), corroborating the visual melting observation.
key_defects: Spatial relationship failure: Elephant is above/behind lions instead of under them.
Counting error: Only 5 lions present instead of 6.
Structural collapse: Elephant legs melt into background haze (severity 4).
Texture anomaly: Heavy grainy noise overlay obscures details (severity 3).
Minor fusion: Lion paws merge slightly with water surface (severity 2).
